articles.title: Rising Prices Become a Big Issue in the US Midterm Elections
articles.summary: Polls show many US voters are worried about rising prices as the November 3 midterm elections approach.

articles.title: Ship Attacks Near the Strait of Hormuz Reach a Weekly High
articles.summary: Attacks on ships near the Strait of Hormuz hit a weekly record, and oil shipments through the waterway have slowed.

articles.title: A Rare Family of Barn Owls Moves Into Manhattan
articles.summary: For the first time in recorded history, a family of barn owls is nesting in Manhattan, and New Yorkers are flocking to see them.
